framework: Hawaii state academic standards: Physical Education
subject: Physical Education

source.publisher: Hawaii state education agency (machine-readable via Common Standards Project / ASN)

units.title: Movement Forms — Use motor skills and movement patterns to perform a variety of physical activities

outcomes.text: Use basic locomotor skills in initial (immature) form alone, with a partner, and in small groups
Use basic non-locomotor skills in initial (immature) form alone, with a partner, and in small groups
Use basic manipulative skills in initial (immature) form alone, with a partner, and in small groups

units.title: Cognitive Concepts — Understand movement concepts, principles, strategies, and tactics as they apply to the learning and performance of physical activities

outcomes.text: Use basic movement concepts related to space, time, effort, and relationships (e.g., personal space, fast/slow, strong/light, under/over)
Identify basic rules for safe participation in physical activities

units.title: Active Lifestyle — Participate regularly in physical activity

outcomes.text: Participate regularly in physical activities
Describe the social and emotional benefits of participating in physical activities

units.title: Physical Fitness — Know ways to achieve and maintain a health-enhancing level of physical fitness

outcomes.text: Identify physiological indicators that accompany moderate to vigorous physical activities

units.title: Movement Forms — Use motor skills and movement patterns to perform a variety of physical activities

outcomes.text: Use locomotor and non-locomotor skills in a mature (proper) form
Use manipulative skills in a mature (proper) form
Use combinations of mature (proper) movement forms, including locomotor, non-locomotor, and manipulative skills

units.title: Cognitive Concepts — Understand movement concepts, principles, strategies, and tactics as they apply to the learning and performance of physical activities

outcomes.text: Apply movement tactics in simple and modified activities
Identify procedures for safe participation in physical activities

units.title: Active Lifestyle — Participate regularly in physical activity

outcomes.text: Participate regularly in physical activities that contribute to an active lifestyle and bring personal enjoyment
Describe health-related benefits of regular participation in physical activities

units.title: Physical Fitness — Know ways to achieve and maintain a health-enhancing level of physical fitness

outcomes.text: Identify the components of health-related physical fitness
Use appropriate methods to monitor physiological changes before, during, and after physical activity
Describe ways in which moderate to vigorous physical activities can improve the health-related components of fitness

units.title: Movement Forms — Use motor skills and movement patterns to perform a variety of physical activities

outcomes.text: Use mature (proper) movement forms appropriately in the context of modified games or activities, such as sports, dance, exercise, and gymnastics
Use combinations of movement forms in the context of modified games or activities, such as sports, dance, exercise, and gymnastics

units.title: Cognitive Concepts — Understand movement concepts, principles, strategies, and tactics as they apply to the learning and performance of physical activities

outcomes.text: Apply rules and etiquette for safe participation in physical activities
Identify strategies to improve performance of movement skills
Describe basic strategies for simple and modified activities

units.title: Active Lifestyle — Participate regularly in physical activity

outcomes.text: Identify opportunities for physical activity outside of the physical education class
Participate regularly in moderate to vigorous physical activities to meet personal goals
Explain the relationship between a healthy lifestyle and regular participation in physical activities

units.title: Physical Fitness — Know ways to achieve and maintain a health-enhancing level of physical fitness

outcomes.text: Describe the principles of training and conditioning and how they affect the components of health-related fitness
Set goals for improving the components of personal health-related physical fitness

units.title: Movement Forms — Use motor skills and movement patterns to perform a variety of physical activities

outcomes.text: Use combinations of specialized movement forms in a variety of activities, such as net and invasion games, field and target games, aquatics, dance, exercise, and gymnastics

units.title: Cognitive Concepts — Understand movement concepts, principles, strategies, and tactics as they apply to the learning and performance of physical activities

outcomes.text: Assess the importance of rules and procedures for safe and fair play during physical activities
Apply concepts, principles, tactics, and strategies to acquire, assess, and improve movement skills
Evaluate tactics and strategies for modified and traditional activities

units.title: Active Lifestyle — Participate regularly in physical activity

outcomes.text: Participate in a variety of physical activities of personal interest to maintain an active lifestyle
Describe reasons for, and healthful benefits of, continuing involvement in personally selected physical activities and identify strategies to do so

units.title: Physical Fitness — Know ways to achieve and maintain a health-enhancing level of physical fitness

outcomes.text: Set goals to improve personal fitness level based on various sources of information
Assess the benefits of participation in selected physical activities on the components of health-related physical fitness
